name: grow-area
title: Grow Area
description: A multi-line field that springs taller a line at a time, with a ring that fills towards the character limit.

perf.budget: A native text input in a box whose height springs; the ring is a tiny Skia canvas with one trimmed arc. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: Measured while typing three long lines and deleting them; the keyboard stays open.

a11y.reducedMotion: The field resizes and the ring fills without springs.
a11y.screenReader: A multi-line text field named by its label, plus a count of characters left.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole field is the target, at least three lines tall.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { GrowArea } from '@/components/kinetik/grow-area';

<GrowArea
  label="About you"
  placeholder="A line or two about yourself"
  value={bio}
  onChangeText={setBio}
  maxLength={160}
  maxLines={6}
/>;
```

## When to use

- Free text whose length varies a lot: a bio, a comment, a note to the seller.
- Text with a hard limit people should see coming before they hit it.

## When not to use

- A single line such as a name or an email. Use Float Field.
- Long documents. Use a dedicated editor screen.

## Notes

- The field starts at `minLines`, springs taller a line at a time and scrolls once it reaches `maxLines`.
- With `maxLength` a ring fills towards the limit; the number of characters left appears in the last 20 and turns red at zero.
- Every other `TextInput` prop is passed through.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add grow-area`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
